GO Wild Area: Gigantamax Machamp Power Up! Timed Research

Fri, Nov 6, 2026, 10:00 AM → Sun, Nov 15, 2026, 11:59 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

Free GO Wild Area research with a Gigantamax Machamp encounter. It was handed out to Trainers who logged in Nov 6–8; if you got it, finish it by Sunday, Nov 15, 11:59 p.m. local time.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Rewards

  • An encounter with Gigantamax Machamp.
  • Machop Candy, Machop Candy XL and Max Particles.

Tasks

  • Walking and catching tasks, including catching Pokémon on several different days, so it can't all be done in one sitting.

Tip

Rewards left unclaimed after Nov 15 are lost, so open the research and collect everything before Sunday night.
